title: Pillow Block Bearings and Shaft Mounts
description: FanPedia's pillow block bearing drawings (p. 92) with six numbered zones: solid ball, solid spherical roller and split pillow blocks, and the set screw, D-Lok / Skwezloc and adapter shaft mounts. Explore mode previews each drawing's name, summary and facts; quiz mode hides the names and describes each drawing, with two attempts, a hint after the first miss and mastery at 5 of 6 on the first attempt.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Pillow block bearing housings and shaft mounts
learningObjectives: The learner will identify the solid (ball and spherical roller) and split pillow block housings and the set screw, D-Lok / Skwezloc and adapter shaft mounts on FanPedia's drawings, given a description of each.

accessibility.notes: The drawing is a labelled SVG group; every numbered drawing is a focusable role=button and Tab walks them in number order; Enter or Space selects one; focus or hover previews its name and description. During the quiz the drawings are named only 'Drawing n' until resolved, labels and leader lines are hidden, and hints never name the answer. Verdicts and prompts are announced through FP.announce (aria-live). ✓/✗ glyphs, solid/dashed borders and an 'Answer' badge pair with colour. Text is 12 px or larger; markers keep a constant pixel size; the label column moves below the drawing on narrow screens.

simulation.modelType: labeled diagram with locate quiz (FP.Overlay grid engine on FP.CalloutQuiz)
rules: Explore mode: hover or focus previews a drawing's name and description; click, Enter or Space opens it and counts it as visited; never scored.
Quiz mode: 6 prompts in a seeded shuffle (the same order for every learner; Start over reshuffles).
Two attempts per prompt; the first wrong answer shows a hint that does not name the answer; the second reveals the answer and counts as missed.
Selecting empty space uses no attempt.
Only first-attempt answers count toward mastery; mastery is 5 of 6.
assumptions: FanPedia p. 92 drawings with the captions removed and the bottom row moved up; zones are percentages of the image.
limitations: Six drawings only; the totally split pillow block is not shown on this FanPedia page.

sources: FanPedia p. 92 (Bearings: Pillow Block Bearings; How Bearings Connect to Shaft): drawings
Drawing: FanPedia, Twin City Fan, p. 92

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore labelled markers on the real FanPedia drawing first, then retrieval practice: find each part from a description of its job, with a hint after the first miss and immediate correction.
keyQuestions: Which housing can be opened by lifting a cap?
Which mounts clamp the inner ring evenly around the shaft?
commonMisconceptions: A split pillow block is a different kind of bearing rather than a different housing.
Every mount pushes the bearing to one side of the shaft.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'First-attempt score: n of 6'; mastery is 5 of 6 on the first attempt.
